title: vertical one choice per line
rule: Vertical one-choice-per-line; space carefully if horizontal.
pass_when: Choices are stacked one per line, or a horizontal row is carefully spaced so each label maps to one control.
fail_when: Crowded horizontal choices that attach the wrong label to a control.
overview: Stack one choice per line; space horizontal rows so labels map clearly.
apply_when: Laying out radio or checkbox choice lists.
not_when: Crowded horizontal choices that attach the wrong label to a control.
agent_hint: Stack choices vertically one per line, or carefully space any horizontal row.
description: Prefer vertical layout with one choice per line for radios and checkboxes. If a horizontal row is used, space carefully so each label maps to one control without ambiguity. Pass when choices are stacked one per line, or a horizontal row is carefully spaced. Fail when crowded horizontal choices attach the wrong label to a control.
